batch_issues: SYSTEMIC: All 28 scripts use the wrong AI disclaimer format. English scripts use a shortened 'educational purposes / not financial advice' disclaimer. Hinglish scripts translate the disclaimer into Hindi. The required format per spec is: 'Disclaimer: This content was created with the help of AI. The presenter in this video is an AI-generated avatar and does not represent a real person.' This must be in English for ALL scripts including hi/ variants.

Topic 01 en/yt_long.md and en/yt_short_01.md both overstate the compounding benefit of 15 bps savings — claim 'several lakhs' / 'lakhs in difference' when the actual figure on a static 10L portfolio is ~1.2 lakh over 20 years.
Topic 02 en/yt_long.md and en/yt_short_01.md both overstate total effective return as 'crosses 330%' when actual calculation yields ~328%.
Topic 02 en/yt_short_02.md has a 24-word sentence and en/yt_short_03.md has a 21-word sentence — both exceed the 20-word limit.
Topic 02 hi/yt_long.md uses masculine verb form 'de deta hoon' instead of feminine 'de deti hoon' for Maya.
Both long-form scripts (Topic 01 and Topic 02, en and hi) have inaccurate text overlay counts in their metadata.
Topic 01 hi/yt_short_03.md CLICKBAIT_TITLE is 71 characters — exceeds the 70-character limit by 1 character.

SYSTEMIC: AI disclaimer text is non-standard across ALL 28 scripts. Every script uses 'AI-generated content for educational purposes only' or similar instead of the mandated format: 'This content was created with the help of AI. The presenter in this video is an AI-generated avatar and does not represent a real person.' All 28 scripts need disclaimer replacement.

Topic 04: Swiggy analogy used in 3 scripts (yt_long pattern interrupt, yt_short_01 core, ig_reel_03 entire premise) + their Hinglish counterparts. Deduplicate — keep in yt_long only, replace in yt_short_01 and ig_reel_03.
Topic 04: 'Your broker is counting on you being emotional. Don't be.' — identical phrasing in en/yt_short_02 and en/ig_reel_02 (and Hinglish counterparts). Rephrase in one.

Topic 04: Math errors propagated across 4 scripts (en/yt_long, en/yt_short_03, hi/yt_long, hi/yt_short_03): (1) RBI 2022 rate hike timeframe stated as 'eighteen months' but actual was ~10 months. (2) EMI increase of '2-3 thousand per month' on 50L home loan from 250 bps hike significantly underestimates reality (~8-10K/month).
Topic 03: Text overlay count mismatch in both en/ and hi/ long-form — claims 8 markers, actual is 11.
Topic 04: Text overlay count mismatch in both en/ and hi/ long-form — claims 6 markers, actual is 8.
Topic 03 en/yt_short_01 description says 'April 1, 2025' — year is wrong, should be omitted or changed to 2026.

ALL 28 scripts use incorrect disclaimer format. Required: 'This content was created with the help of AI. The presenter in this video is an AI-generated avatar and does not represent a real person.' Actual: varies between 'AI-generated and for educational purposes only' and 'AI-generated content for educational purposes only.' Some also include 'Consult a qualified financial advisor' which echoes Maya's forbidden patterns. Systematic fix needed across all scripts.
Topic 05: Debt MF indexation benefit claim is factually wrong (removed by Finance Act 2023). Appears in en/yt_long.md, hi/yt_long.md, en/yt_short_03.md, hi/yt_short_03.md — 4 scripts affected.

Topic 06: Swiggy sale analogy used in both yt_long.md (pattern interrupt) and yt_short_01.md (entire hook/framing) in both en/ and hi/ — 4 scripts share the same analogy. yt_short_01 should use a different hook to stand alone as a genuinely different video.
Topic 06: Both long-form scripts (en/ and hi/) likely exceed the 750-word cap. Self-reported counts (720 and 730) appear understated compared to actual body text.
